div.div:
Every child has exactly one parent; each parent has 0..many children. Deletion labels are Django ORM policies.
New recordings get new attempt UUIDs; processing retries retain the UUID and source audio.
PDF/audio/image bytes live in shared media. Timeline words and repeated slide visits remain JSON within Attempt.
